skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 200% ATK to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5000% ATK of Specialized Direct DMG (only affected by high-level DMG Free) to all enemies, ignores 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces through [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].Inflicts [Energy Suppression] on the 3 enemies with highest ATK, lasting 2 turns.——— [Energy Suppression]: when dealing DMG to HP/[Specialized HP], causes the target to activate 1x [Energy Conversion] (reduces DMG received and converts it into [Shield]).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Gains 20% [Rage] and [Shield Break]. ATK 5000% > 7000%. Ignores [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 45% > 60%. Inflicts [Energy Suppression] on 3 enemies > all enemies (marked for 3 turns).——— [Shield Break]: during an attack, ignore the enemy's 30% DMG Free and Specialized DEF.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: On entry, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and reduces to 0 the energy used by the ally with highest ATK when casting their Ultimate.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 60% > 70%. Energy-reduction window 4 > 6 rounds.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] on entry 70% > 80%. Energy-reduction window 6 > 8 rounds.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Allow Hero/Martial Artist allies to obtain [Energy Conversion]. Ownself gains 2.5x of allies' [Energy Conversion] effect, and when activating [Energy Conversion], no need [Energy Suppression]. ——— [Energy Conversion]: When an enemy with [Energy Suppression] attacks DMG to us, reduce DMG by 20%, 20% of original DMG is converted to [Energy Resilience]

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, inflict [Energy Suppression] to all enemies, lasts for 1 round. [Energy Conversion]: reduce DMG by 20% > 30% Original DMG is converted to [Energy Resilience] 20% > 30%

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
When an enemy carrying [Energy Suppression] damages the carrier, the damage is reduced by 20% and the reduction is converted into energy.
Reduces damage taken from critical hits by a certain percentage.
The shield type converts its cumulative value into damage reduction, is limited to a multiple of the unit's maximum Health, and cannot be used with Resurrection.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Evasion PvP tier — reduces specialized attacks to 1 damage; pierced by the ignore dodge effect.
While attacking, ignore the enemy's 30% Damage Immunity and Unique Defense to allow the attack to penetrate their shield.
Attack buff increases unit damage, often accompanied by [Shield Break].
The absorption barrier, usually created from transmogrified damage, absorbs damage before health is affected.
When dealing damage to health, forces the target to activate Energy Conversion, reducing the damage they deal and choking their mana source.
